Delhivery sub Ecom Express gets ₹1.78 Cr GST demand from UP authority

Key Highlights
Ecom Express received a GST demand order of ₹1.78 crore from UP SGST authority
Total liability includes ₹1.34 crore interest and ₹0.18 crore penalty
Demand relates to disallowance of input tax credit for FY23
Delhivery states no material impact on financials or operations
powered by
*this image is generated using AI for illustrative purposes only.
Delhivery Limited subsidiary Ecom Express received a Goods and Services Tax demand order of ₹1.78 crore from Uttar Pradesh authorities on October 28, 2026.
The order, issued under Section 73 of the Uttar Pradesh Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017, relates to fiscal year 2022-23. The total liability includes tax demand of ₹1,78,56,452, interest of ₹1,33,93,806, and penalty of ₹17,85,645. The demand stems from the disallowance of input tax credit.
Regulatory Disclosure Details
Delhivery disclosed this development pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Regulations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The filing confirms that Ecom Express is a wholly owned subsidiary of Delhivery. The company stated that it will take necessary steps regarding the order.

Impact Assessment
The company asserted that there is no material impact on the financials, operations, or other activities of Ecom Express or Delhivery. The disclosure was filed with BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The document was signed by Madhulika Rawat, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

Delhivery wins Golden Peacock Award for Excellence in Corporate Governance 2026
1 min read | Published on 12 Oct 2026, 01:56 PM |Updated on 12 Oct 2026, 01:56 PM
Reviewed by
Naman SScanX News Team
Add as a preferred
source on Google
Key Highlights
Delhivery won the Golden Peacock Award for Excellence in Corporate Governance 2026
Award given by Institute of Directors in the Logistics sector
Jury chaired by Former Chief Justice Uday U. Lalit
Presentation scheduled for November 2026 London Global Convention
powered by
*this image is generated using AI for illustrative purposes only.
Delhivery Limited has been recognized as the winner of the Golden Peacock Award for Excellence in Corporate Governance 2026 (National) in the Logistics sector. The award is presented by the Institute of Directors (IOD), India, acknowledging the company's adherence to rigorous governance standards.
The recognition follows an evaluation against the Golden Peacock Excellence Model, which assesses sustainability-driven excellence. The award was adjudged by a distinguished jury chaired by Hon'ble Justice Uday U. Lalit, Former Chief Justice of India. This national accolade highlights Delhivery's commitment to maintaining high ethical and operational standards within the logistics industry.
Leadership Comments on Recognition
Vivek Pabari, Chief Financial Officer, stated that the award validates the company's emphasis on governance. He noted that the recognition inspires the team to continuously improve their practices. Madhulika Rawat, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, emphasized that effective governance serves as the foundation for every decision made at the organization. She added that this acknowledgment from the Institute of Directors confirms their efforts to set higher standards across the enterprise.
About the Golden Peacock Awards
Instituted by the Institute of Directors in 1991, the Golden Peacock Awards recognize organizations across various categories of corporate excellence. The awards are known for their rigorous evaluation benchmarks and independent jury assessments.
The 2026 awards for Corporate Governance will be formally presented during the Annual London Global Convention on Corporate Governance & Sustainability scheduled for November 2026. This event brings together global leaders to discuss best practices in corporate governance and sustainability.
Company Profile
Delhivery is India's largest logistics services provider. The company offers a comprehensive suite of services including:
E-commerce and express parcel transportation
Part truck-load (PTL) and full-truckload (FTL) freight
Warehousing and supply chain solutions
International freight
Intra-city on-demand logistics
Data solutioning and software as a service (SaaS)
The company serves over 54,000 clients with solutions such as warehouse management and transportation management systems. Delhivery has been listed on the National Stock Exchange and Bombay Stock Exchange since May 2022.
